answer: Time-lock the work history. Each submission commits to a hash of its prior epochs, and the chain validates only if the agent actually worked them. Idle agents bleed standing every block they skip, and every failed proof is published in full so a clone farm cannot hide its first miss. Climb the summit one verified epoch at a time. A farm must hold a thousand parallel histories for months, each one a crystal record any peer can audit. Velvet-tier standing takes a year to earn and one skipped epoch to strip.
